title: Tight End-to-End Accounting for Differentially Private Synthetic Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.17249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differentially private (DP) pipelines often combine heterogeneous mechanisms, yet their guarantees are best analyzed using different notions of privacy (e.g., bounded range, zCDP, ADP). When composing them, we have to analyze the guarantees through a reduced common representation that loses accounting precision. This issue is particularly relevant in DP synthetic data generation, where data preprocessing, generation algorithms, and DP-SGD could appear within the same pipeline. We develop novel tools for tight end-to-end accounting of such compositions using privacy loss distributions (PLD), $f$-DP, and Gaussian DP (GDP). In particular, we derive PLD and GDP analyses of bounded-range mechanisms such as the Exponential mechanism. Building on these theoretical results, we introduce AIM-GDP, a GDP-native variant of AIM (a state-of-the-art DP synthetic data mechanism) that enables easy composability with complex pipelines via PLD, attack-aw

translated_title: 差分隐私合成数据的紧致端到端隐私核算
translated_abstract: 差分隐私（DP）流水线通常组合多种异构机制，而这些机制的隐私保证最好使用不同的隐私定义来分析（如有界范围、zCDP、ADP）。在组合这些机制时，我们必须通过一种简化的通用表示来分析其保证，这会导致核算精度的损失。这一问题在DP合成数据生成中尤为突出，因为数据预处理、生成算法和DP-SGD可能同时出现在同一流水线中。我们开发了新颖的工具，利用隐私损失分布（PLD）、$f$-DP和高斯差分隐私（GDP）对这类组合进行紧致的端到端核算。特别地，我们推导了诸如指数机制等有界范围机制的PLD和GDP分析。基于这些理论结果，我们提出了AIM-GDP，这是AIM（一种最先进的DP合成数据机制）的GDP原生变体，可通过PLD实现与复杂流水线的便捷组合，……
tldr: 本文开发了基于隐私损失分布（PLD）、f-DP和高斯差分隐私（GDP）的紧致端到端隐私核算工具，并提出了GDP原生的AIM变体AIM-GDP，实现了差分隐私合成数据流水线中异构机制的精确组合分析。
en_tdlr: This paper develops novel tight end-to-end privacy accounting tools based on privacy loss distributions (PLD), f-DP, and Gaussian DP (GDP), and introduces AIM-GDP, a GDP-native variant of AIM, enabling precise composability analysis of heterogeneous mechanisms in DP synthetic data pipelines.
